name: Munshi Abdur Rouf
contribution: During fighting near Rangamati, he defended retreating troops with sustained machine-gun fire and died under shelling.
impact: His action remains one of the most cited examples of combat sacrifice in the war.
highlight: He turned a retreat into survival through final-cover fire.
